projects.title: Feasibility study for an industrial estate in a Special Economic Zone
projects.problem: A client needed to assess the feasibility of developing an industrial estate inside a Special Economic Zone.
projects.approach: Built the research framework, analysed SEZ performance and benchmarks, ran a highest-and-best-use study, and projected financials (NPV, IRR, payback) with sensitivity analysis on price, occupancy, cost, and discount rate.
projects.result: Delivered strategic recommendations, a research report, an executive summary, and presentation materials to the client.

projects.title: Budget realisation analysis across 46 regional offices
projects.problem: A programme ran across 46 regional offices with a budget of about IDR 210 billion, and its realisation had to be tracked every month.
projects.approach: Monitored realisation by office, identified deviations and their causes, developed 60 facility standards, and ran quarterly evaluations.
projects.result: Budget absorption reached 93.59% of the IDR 210 billion total.

projects.title: Price benchmarks and equipment standards for MSME ventures
projects.problem: A bottled-water pilot project at Islamic boarding schools needed fair reference prices and equipment specifications.
projects.approach: Ran field surveys, issued an RFI to 15 national vendors, compared prices and specifications, and modelled target cascading by province.
projects.result: The price benchmarks and equipment standards became the basis for running the pilot.

projects.title: Training dashboard for 900+ employees
projects.problem: Employee training data was handled manually, so reporting took a lot of time.
projects.approach: Migrated the data to Power BI and built an interactive training performance dashboard.
projects.result: Manual reporting dropped by 25 hours a week and training insights became easy for the team to access.
